# FaMED Prep — independent preparation resources

FaMED Prep is independent of the official FaMed examination provider. Human-medicine facts checked 18 October 2026; recheck changing fees, booking and authority conditions before publication.

## Current examination sources

- Format: https://famed-test.de/pruefungsablauf/
- Human-medicine practice test 2026: https://famed-test.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/FaMed-Uebungstest_2-1.pdf
- Requirements: https://famed-test.de/anforderungen/
- Results: https://famed-test.de/pruefungsergebnis/
- Fee and centres: https://famed-test.de/faq/

Three stations/five tasks: history and consent; two patient presentations; written anamnesis from a video. Oral blocks 23 minutes including reading, individual situations maximum 11 minutes in the current practice PDF. Written task 22 minutes including video; complete sentences and appropriate reported speech. Each station requires 60%. Medical knowledge is not separately assessed. No verified universal 30-second preparation rule, pass-rate statistic or exam-case frequency.

FAQ lists €530 exam fee and Mainz/Kassel/Nürnberg as of the check date. Provider recognition overview is dated November 2025; authority and qualification conditions govern. Passing the language exam does not itself issue Approbation or Berufserlaubnis.

## Independent preparation resources

- Blog: https://famed-vorbereitung.com/blog
- Book sample, current designed 2026 edition: https://famed-vorbereitung.com/blog/famed-protokoll-buch-vorschau
- Digital book promotional price: €19.99. Final amount is shown at checkout. https://famedtestprep.com/protokolle
- App explained: https://famed-vorbereitung.com/blog/famed-prep-app-so-funktionierts
- Free guide: https://famed-vorbereitung.com/lead-magnet
- Writing task: https://famed-vorbereitung.com/blog/famed-arztbrief-soap-schema

Do not call the independent book official, claim it predicts all cases, substitute Academy prototype UI, or insert placeholder images. Generated text requires source review before publication. Older book/class drafts can contain superseded exam timings; current primary sources take precedence.

English is the default language. Arabic equivalents are under /ar/; German examples stay in German for learning. General app graphics must not advertise a fixed access duration. Contextual book links can go directly to https://famedtestprep.com/PayPalCheckout?plan=book_only .
